description.zh: 云手机实例描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en: The description of the cloud phone instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The instance ID of the cloud phone.

description.zh: 云手机实例名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。
description.en: The name of the cloud phone instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 云手机密钥名称。为提高实例安全性，强烈建议您使用密钥对的连接方式。
description.en: The name of the key pair for the cloud phone. To improve instance security, use a key pair for connection.
The resolution of the cloud phone, such as 1920×1080.

description.zh: 实例的标签键。N的取值范围为1~20。
description.en: The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

description.zh: 实例的标签值。N的取值范围为1~20。
description.en: The tag value of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

description.zh:
云手机VNC密码。
密码长度必须是六位字符，必须且仅能包含大写、小写英文字母及阿拉伯数字三种字符。
description.en: The VNC password of the cloud phone. The password must be exactly six characters in length and must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits.

descriptions.zh: 调用该接口，可以修改云手机的实例名称、密钥、描述、VNC密码、实例分辨率，其中密钥、分辨率修改需要重启实例后生效。
descriptions.en: Calls this operation to modify the instance name, key pair, description, VNC password, or resolution of a cloud phone instance. Changes to the key pair and resolution take effect only after the instance is restarted.
